description: A shell script for testing git repository cloning with submodules, remote-tracking branches, and partial clone features.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success, with a description and commands.

methods.name: test_commit
methods.description: Creates a commit with a specified message.

methods.name: test_diff
methods.description: Checks for differences in git repositories.

methods.name: test_config_global
methods.description: Sets global git configuration for testing.

methods.name: test_when_finished
methods.description: Registers cleanup commands to run after tests.
